associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: An auxiliary relation between two rings equipped with algebra structures over a common field.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The auxiliary algebra relation is unchanged when its two ring arguments are exchanged.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The auxiliary algebra relation implies the associated auxiliary relation on the underlying rings.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The auxiliary algebra relation composes through an intermediate algebra.
